findings: Sidebar contrast color deviation — The implemented --sidebar-text-active: #9F1239 is lighter than the plan's #7F1D1D, reducing contrast against the pill background. Use the darker value specified in the plan to meet the intended WCAG contrast ratio.

Unauthorized backend validation logic — SSISController::decideEnrollment now includes clearance hold checks, conflict flag validation, section capacity enforcement, and schedule conflict detection—none of which were part of the task scope. Remove these additions or justify why they're necessary to fix the enrollment status display bug.

Role authorization enforcement — The backend now rejects approval requests from non-registrar roles with a 403 response, and the frontend duplicates this check in RegistrarApprovalsView. This was not part of the task and introduces a new authorization model without test coverage. Remove or verify against existing auth patterns.

Section model status expansion — Section.php methods hasOpenSlot and availableSlots now count both 'Approved' and 'Enrolled' statuses, implying these are now semantically equivalent. This change was not mentioned in the plan and may conflict with the intent to distinguish pending approval from enrolled state. Clarify or revert.

Frontend validation duplication — RegistrarApprovalsView checks validation fields (noConflicts, prerequisites, financeCleared, profileComplete) and shows toast messages before calling approveEnrollmentRequest, which then performs the same checks again. This wasn't in the plan and adds complexity. Remove the duplicate checks from the view or from the context.

StudentEnrollmentView changes missing — The plan specified deriving actualEnrollmentStatus from myEnrollment in StudentEnrollmentView.jsx and updating the badge display logic, but the diff shows no changes to that file (though the commit summary references it). Verify the enrollment view displays the correct status after approval.

Backend API contract change — decideEnrollment now interprets 'Approved' status as 'Enrolled' ($status = ($rawStatus === 'Approved' || $rawStatus === 'Enrolled') ? 'Enrolled' : $rawStatus;), silently rewriting the client's intent. This normalization was not in the plan and may break existing API consumers. Remove or document.
